The '''Junction''' was a major environment purification facility active on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in [[3643 BBY]] and crucial for the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]]. Under the influence of the [[Dark Plague]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cin Tykan]] tried to sabotage it.

{{Struct-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Junction first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a story phase for the [[Jedi Consular]] class on Taris. On the Republic version of Taris, the Junction is located in the [[Brell Sediment]]. However, it also appears in the Imperial version of Taris, except that it has been moved to the [[Tularan Marsh]] and the [[Second Colonial Protectorate]] has replaced the Junction's original location. This article assumes that the Tularan Marsh placement is accurate, as the Second Colonial Protectorate would otherwise not exist.
